settings.title: Draw charts and diagrams
settings.summary: Draws the charts and diagrams a reply holds, instead of their code.
settings.description: Whether charts and diagrams in a reply are drawn. On, a fenced chart block is drawn as a chart and a fenced mermaid block as a diagram, and the model is told how to write them (visuals.instructions). Off, both are shown as code blocks and the model is told nothing.

settings.title: Chart and diagram instructions
settings.summary: What a model is told about drawing charts and diagrams.
settings.default: When a chart or a diagram would make an answer clearer than words alone, you may draw one in your reply; otherwise answer in words. A diagram is a fenced code block with the language mermaid, holding Mermaid source. A chart is a fenced code block with the language chart, holding one JSON object and nothing else: {"type": "bar", "title": "...", "x": {"title": "...", "labels": ["..."]}, "y": {"title": "..."}, "series": [{"name": "...", "values": [1, 2]}]}. The type is bar, line, area, pie or scatter. Each series has one value for each label. A pie has one series, and its labels name the slices. A scatter chart has no labels, and each series has "points": [[x, y]] in place of values. Use plain numbers and only a few series, and say in a sentence what the visual shows.
settings.description: What a model is told about drawing charts and diagrams in a reply, added to the standing instructions while visuals.draw is on. It is the same in every call, so the start of a call stays cacheable. Empty tells the model nothing; blocks it writes anyway are still drawn.

settings.title: Chart or diagram size
settings.summary: The largest chart or diagram that is drawn.
settings.description: The largest chart or diagram block that is drawn, in bytes. A larger one is shown as its source with a note.

settings.title: Series in a chart
settings.summary: The most series a chart may have, or slices of a pie.
settings.description: The most series a chart may have, and the most slices of a pie. A chart with more is shown as its source with a note. The design has six series colours; past six they repeat.

settings.title: Points in a series
settings.summary: The most points one series of a chart may have.
settings.description: The most points one series of a chart may have. A chart with more is shown as its source with a note.

settings.title: Chart label length
settings.summary: The longest a chart's title, label or series name may be.
settings.description: The most characters a chart's title, an axis title, a label or a series name may have.

settings.title: Chart height
settings.summary: How tall a chart is drawn in a reply.
settings.description: How tall a chart is drawn in a reply, in pixels, at least 120. A chart still being written holds a place of this height, so the page does not jump when it draws.

settings.title: Diagram height
settings.summary: How tall a diagram's frame is in a reply.
settings.description: How tall a diagram's frame is in a reply, in pixels, at least 120. The diagram is fitted inside it, and Open larger shows it at the size of the window.

settings.title: Diagram wait
settings.summary: How long the page waits for a diagram to draw.
settings.description: How long the page waits for a diagram's frame to draw before it shows the diagram's source with a note instead.
